intro: This severed head is proof of the death of Athrikus Narassin, an ancient warlock who directed dark rituals in northern Darkshore. Taken from the heights of the ruined spire, it serves to confirm the disruption of demonic activity centered around the Tower of Althalaxx.

p: Perched at the pinnacle of the Tower of Althalaxx, Athrikus Narassin commanded a coven of dark sorcerers practicing fel magic along the Darkshore coast. Ancient and entrenched, Narassin coordinated demonic summonings that threatened the surrounding wilderness. Claiming his head shatters the coven's leadership, driving back their immediate foothold in the region, even if the lingering corruption promises future vigilance will be needed.
